fields.label: Enable S3 Attachment
fields.description: Master switch. Enable this to start uploading new file attachments to your S3-compatible cloud storage.

fields.label: Region Name
fields.description: AWS region (e.g. us-east-1) or provider-specific region. Leave blank if not required.

fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: S3-API endpoint used for all credentialed operations (uploads, signed reads, deletes). Must include scheme — a bare hostname is auto-prefixed with https:// on save. Examples: Cloudflare R2 — https://<account_id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com | Oracle Object Storage — https://<namespace>.compat.objectstorage.<region>.oraclecloud.com | MinIO — http://localhost:9000 | Leave blank for native AWS S3.

fields.label: CDN / Public URL (Optional, Performance Only)
fields.description: TRULY OPTIONAL — leave blank for a universal setup that works on every S3-compatible provider. By default, public files are served via a Frappe-side signed-URL redirect (1 extra hop, no CDN caching). Set this field only if you want public files served directly from a CDN/public hostname for browser-cacheable delivery. Examples: https://cdn.example.com, https://pub-xxx.r2.dev. Must point at the same bucket as Endpoint URL. Must include scheme; a bare hostname is auto-prefixed with https:// on save.

fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: Optional prefix/folder prepended to every uploaded object key.

fields.label: Per-Company Folders
fields.description: When enabled, prepend a per-company segment (Company.abbr) to every uploaded object key, derived from the parent document's company field. Files attached to docs without a company field (Customer, Item, Letter Head, ad-hoc uploads) go under _shared/. Existing files are not relocated; only new uploads get the new layout.

fields.label: Signed URL Expiry Time (seconds)
fields.description: Expiry time in seconds for pre-signed URLs used to access private files.

fields.label: Force Path Style
fields.description: Use path-style S3 URLs ({endpoint}/{bucket}/{key}) instead of virtual-hosted style ({bucket}.{endpoint}/{key}). Required for Oracle Object Storage, MinIO, and some other S3-compatible providers.

fields.label: Ignore SSL Certificate Verification
fields.description: Disable SSL/TLS certificate verification. Use only with self-signed certificates in trusted, internal networks. NOT recommended for production.

fields.label: Disable Object ACL
fields.description: Skip the per-object x-amz-acl header on uploads. REQUIRED for Cloudflare R2 (and any S3-compatible provider that does not support ACLs). When enabled, public access must be configured at the bucket level (e.g. R2 custom domain or pub-xxx.r2.dev URL set in CDN / Public URL above).

fields.label: Rewrite Stored File URLs
fields.description: Bulk-rewrite the file_url of public File rows when you've changed the public hostname after files were already uploaded. Prompts for the old prefix and previews the change before writing.

fields.label: Test S3 Connection
fields.description: Upload a test file and generate public/private download links to verify S3 is working.
